expr: ((xs.find? (fun x => decide (xs.countP (fun y => y = x) = (xs.map (fun x => xs.countP (fun y => y = x))).foldl max 0))).getD 0)

lemmas.name: most55_a
lemmas.statement: ∀ (xs : List Int) (h : mostFrequent_precond xs) (r : Int), r ∈ xs → (∀ x, x ∈ xs → xs.countP (fun y => y = x) ≤ xs.countP (fun y => y = r)) → xs.find? (fun x => decide (xs.countP (fun y => y = x) = xs.countP (fun y => y = r))) = some r → mostFrequent_postcond xs r h
lemmas.proof:
by intro xs h r hmem hall hfirst
  unfold mostFrequent_postcond
  dsimp only
  refine ⟨hmem, List.all_eq_true.mpr fun x hx => by simpa using hall x hx, ?_⟩
  rw [List.head?_filter]; exact hfirst

lemmas.name: most55
lemmas.statement: ∀ (xs : List Int) (h : mostFrequent_precond xs), mostFrequent_postcond xs ((xs.find? (fun x => decide (xs.countP (fun y => y = x) = (xs.map (fun x => xs.countP (fun y => y = x))).foldl max 0))).getD 0) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro xs h
  have hne : xs.map (fun x => xs.countP (fun y => y = x)) ≠ [] := by simpa using h
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := Refine.maxlist_nat _ hne
  rw [List.contains_iff_mem, List.mem_map] at h1
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hcx0⟩ := h1
  have hany : xs.any (fun x => decide ((xs.countP (fun y => y = x)) = (xs.map (fun x => xs.countP (fun y => y = x))).foldl max 0)) = true :=
    List.any_eq_true.mpr ⟨x0, hx0, by simpa using hcx0⟩
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hmem, hp⟩ := Refine.find_some_of_any xs _ hany
  have hcr := of_decide_eq_true hp
  have e : (xs.find? (fun x => decide (xs.countP (fun y => y = x) = (xs.map (fun x => xs.countP (fun y => y = x))).foldl max 0))).getD 0 = r := by rw [hr]; rfl
  rw [e]
  refine most55_a xs h r hmem ?_ ?_
  · intro x hx
    have := List.all_eq_true.mp h2 _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩)
    rw [hcr]; simpa using this
  · rw [hcr]; exact hr
